summary: UI PHASE 2 (Development Panel reorganization) verified end-to-end against public URL. All 11 review-request items PASSED. Panel opens with the exact ordering specified: (1) Scaffolding Controller accordion FIRST — aria-expanded=true by default, scaffolding-control-block content visible; (2) Integration & Calibration accordion IMMEDIATELY AFTER — aria-expanded=true, integration-calibration-block content visible; (3) 'Primary Active Framework' group header with the correctly-picked primary framework (Communicative Purpose in the argue-social-media session, matched via 'central claim'/'thesis' keywords), primary badge (data-testid='framework-status-primary', icon + 'Primary' text) rendered, and its content block (communicative-purpose-block) auto-visible without any clicks; (4) 'Other Applicable Frameworks' group is correctly OMITTED when there are no supporting/applicable/postponed frameworks (this session had none — verified through the FRAMEWORKS.applies() gating on the preset argue-social-media session where only communicative_purpose.applies==true); (5) 'Inactive Frameworks' group with 6 accordions (paragraph/evidence/coherence/conclusion/reader/revision), each with a 'Not applicable' badge (framework-status-not_applicable, icon + text), each collapsed by default — confirmed that their content blocks (e.g. paragraph-function-block) are ABSENT from the DOM until the accordion is expanded (AnimatePresence removes on exit); (6) 'Instructional Output' group with intervention accordion expanded by default, selected-invitation + intervention-block visible; (7) 'Working Theory Detail' group with 'Full engine internals' accordion collapsed by default (candidate-invitation-0 not in DOM until expanded). Manual mouse click on any collapsed accordion reveals its content and toggles aria-expanded correctly; clicking again removes it from the DOM. Keyboard accessibility works: focusing the toggle and pressing Enter toggles aria-expanded (true<->false), then Space toggles back — full keyboard control confirmed. POLLING STABILITY (CRITICAL) verified two ways: (a) with a completed session and no processing turn, manually collapsed Scaffolding Controller + manually expanded paragraph_function, then idled for 10 seconds — both states preserved (sc=false, pf=true); (b) submitted a NEW revise turn while manually-set state was in place, panel opened during the ~60s LLM window, panel-processing-indicator (data-testid) rendered, prior completed turn's reasoning still visible (never blanked to placeholder), manual accordion state PRESERVED across 10s of active 2.5s polling (no thrash) — confirming the openMap-only-recomputes-on-turnKey-change discipline in DevelopmentPanel.jsx L448-454 is correctly wired. NEW-TURN DEFAULT RESET verified: once the revise turn's ai_turn.status flipped to complete (interactions.length grew from 1 to 2), the openMap re-derived from computeDefaults(theory) — Scaffolding Controller aria-expanded=true, Integration aria-expanded=true, paragraph_function collapsed, detail collapsed (defaults re-applied). Reload restores completed panel identically: after page reload with the completed session, panel opens with defaults exactly as first render (sc/ic/primary expanded, inactive collapsed) and NO data loss (scaffolding-control-block still shows primary_target 'Drafting a first body paragraph...', integration-calibration-block still shows 'Central Claim / Thesis...' primary framework). Zero duplicate panels observed at any point. Backend smoke (Phase 1 durable processing regression) PASSED: POST /api/sessions/{id}/interact latency 0.10s (immediate return), concurrent second POST returns 409, polling GET /api/sessions/{id} reaches status='complete' in ~54s, intervention.focus='writing', scaffolding_control.primary_target populated ('Sharpen the claim's key term...'), integration_calibration.applies=true with primary_framework='Central Claim / Thesis — key term precision'. Full backend flow is unchanged.

action_items: None blocking. UI Phase 2 (Dev Panel reorganization) meets every acceptance item in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: DevelopmentPanel.jsx L448-454 (openMap useState/useEffect keyed on turnKey + session?.id) — this is the pivot of the whole phase and it is correct. Recomputation happens ONLY when interactions.length changes or the session id changes, which is the exact contract the review request specifies. Empirically verified: manually collapsed sc + expanded pf were preserved through ~14 poll cycles of the 2.5s polling loop (App.js L54-76) during an active processing turn, then automatically reset once interactions.length ticked from 1 to 2. The linter-disable for exhaustive-deps is justified — we specifically do NOT want `theory` in the deps, since polling mutates the theory reference on every fetch.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx pickPrimary() L309-324 + frameworkStatuses() L326-343 — keyword-based heuristic against integration_calibration.primary_framework works well. On the argue-social-media preset it correctly matched 'Central Claim / Thesis...' to communicative_purpose via the 'central claim'/'thesis' keywords (earliest-index tiebreak, so 'central claim' at pos 0 wins). On the revise turn it re-matched to 'Revision Development —' via revision_development keywords once revision_development.applies flipped true. Postponed detection: the session's postponed list included 'evidence interpretation', 'paragraph coherence', 'conclusion' — but since those frameworks all had applies=false in this test session they were categorized as not_applicable (correct precedence: applies=false is checked FIRST at L335). This means the 'Postponed' badge is only visible when a framework has applies=true AND its keyword appears in scaffolding_control.postponed — which is the intended semantic (a still-applicable framework that is being deliberately postponed for this cycle).

DevelopmentPanel.jsx Accordion component L89-129 — clean implementation of the a11y contract: button + aria-expanded + aria-controls, focus-visible ring, AnimatePresence for content in/out. Content is REMOVED from the DOM on collapse (initial=false so no flash on first render), matching the review request's note about DOM assertions.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx Badge component L74-87 — status is communicated with icon + text label (Target/Link2/Clock/Circle/MinusCircle + 'Primary'/'Supporting'/'Postponed'/'Applicable'/'Not applicable'), never color alone. Meets WCAG 1.4.1 (color not the sole means of conveying information).

DevelopmentPanel.jsx panel-processing-indicator L516-524 — the indicator is gated on `(session?.turns || []).some(t => t.status === 'processing')` which correctly derives from the polled session snapshot. During the 60s revise turn the indicator remained visible until the ai_turn flipped to complete. Since the reasoning view uses `interactions[interactions.length - 1]` (which is set only when the AI turn completes and its interaction is appended by _apply_engine_result at server.py), the panel correctly shows the PREVIOUS completed turn's reasoning during the ~60s window — never blank, never partial. This is the exact 'no-blank-during-processing' behavior specified in the review request.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx grouping logic L462-467 — clean partitioning of FRAMEWORKS into primaryFw / otherApplicable / inactive, with 'Other Applicable Frameworks' group conditionally rendered only when otherApplicable.length > 0. This yields a compact panel for sessions like the argue-social-media preset where only one framework applies.

DevelopmentPanel.jsx computeDefaults() L345-359 — expands primary + supporting, collapses everything else including 'applicable' and 'postponed'. This matches the review-request bullet: 'inactive/postponed/plain-applicable collapse'. Verified against both a completed writing turn (all inactive collapsed, primary/supporting expanded) and after the revise turn's defaults reset (still correct).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 is a pure frontend reorganization of DevelopmentPanel.jsx and does not require any backend re-verification beyond the Phase 1 durable-processing smoke. To reproduce panel testing quickly: (1) load https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com/?dev, (2) `localStorage.setItem('dws_session_id','c12ef0e0-e9a6-4c29-8265-97354594b18e')` and reload — this session has 3 completed interactions and populated theory that exercises Primary + all-Inactive groupings; (3) click [data-testid='open-dev-panel-button']. Key invariant to preserve across future changes: openMap must re-derive ONLY on interactions.length OR session?.id change (currently the useEffect deps at L454), NOT on any other prop that mutates per poll — otherwise the manual accordion state will thrash every 2.5s. The 'Other Applicable Frameworks' group could not be exercised with the current test sessions (all frameworks were either primary or applies=false); if a future phase adds a session where multiple frameworks have applies=true, verify that the supporting badge (framework-status-supporting) and applicable badge (framework-status-applicable) render correctly under that group header. Primary framework matching is a keyword heuristic on integration_calibration.primary_framework — if the M14 prompt starts emitting primary_framework strings that don't contain any of the keywords listed in FRAMEWORKS[*].keywords, pickPrimary returns null and the 'Primary Active Framework' group will be omitted. Public URL: https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com.
